title: Customer and item posting fields controlled fit decision
purpose: Decide the next safe customer/item posting-field route after TARGET-044D exposed some standard card context but did not prove enough visible field/value truth for a write.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036D2H has parked vendor numbering or selected a separate vendor gate.
U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 exist as basic records, but posting/VAT/O2C readiness is not proven.
acceptanceCriteria: No Business Central or Playwright execution occurs in this decision case.
The decision names exact customer/item fields that would need values before O2C/P2P.
The decision separates field visibility from field correctness.
The next case is either a materially new read-only UI/source route or a small controlled write gate with exact field/value scope.
Preview Posting, Posting and documents remain locked.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-044D inspected U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 read-only, but did not expose enough posting/VAT/inventory field and value truth for a safe write. TARGET-031B/032B prove selected posting-group prerequisites, while TARGET-027D24 and TARGET-032F keep VAT Posting Setup and General Posting Setup parked.
nextStepDecision.reason: A no-write field-fit decision is still the safest step because Business Central posting groups and VAT posting setup determine later G/L/VAT account selection; visible customer/item card labels alone are not posting readiness.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Exact source-backed customer/item field and target value mapping is needed before any UI write route.
Only useful after TARGET-045A names exact fields, values and a materially different read-only route.
O2C remains blocked while VAT Posting Setup, General Posting Setup and item inventory posting correctness are not proven.
Vendor creation remains blocked while U-VEND Manual Nos is parked.
No Preview Posting before master data and setup boundaries are explicit.

queueChangesMade: Marked TARGET-045 done as no-write controlled-fit decision.
Added TARGET-045A-CUSTOMER-ITEM-FIELD-SOURCE-MAPPING as the next pending local source-mapping case.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It converts the observed UI gaps into an exact field/value/source map and prevents another blind customer or item write attempt.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not write Customer Posting Group, Gen. Bus. Posting Group, VAT Bus. Posting Group, Item Posting Group, Gen. Prod. Posting Group or VAT Prod. Posting Group until TARGET-045A classifies exact values and unresolved setup gaps.
Do not treat INLAND/WAREN/VAT19 candidate codes as a complete posting setup or VAT proof.
Do not start O2C/P2P documents, Preview Posting or Posting from field visibility.
requiredPreparation: Read TARGET-031B, TARGET-032B, TARGET-032F, TARGET-027D24, TARGET-040 and TARGET-044D boundaries.
Map customer and item fields separately and mark each field as ready-to-write, needs-ui-route, or blocked-by-setup.
Keep the next case local unless it selects a narrow new read-only route.

resultSummary: Customer/item posting field write remains locked; exact field/value/source mapping is required before any write or O2C preflight.
